vulnerabilities.sink_description: htmlescape() allocates `malloc(strlen(src)+10)` then strcat()s multi-byte HTML entity replacements (e.g. """ = 6 bytes) while advancing with an off-by-one `while(*s++)` loop and a too-loose `off >= len-8` guard, so a text value with many escapable characters overruns the heap buffer. Reached from output_TEXT() at dwg2SVG.c:135 / :400.

evidence.asan_summary: heap-buffer-overflow READ/WRITE in htmlescape via strcat, ../../programs/escape.c:46/48/51, called from output_TEXT at dwg2SVG.c
evidence.note: CVE-2020-21816/21818/21819 are the same htmlescape heap overflow pinned to escape.c lines 46/48/51 in GNU LibreDWG 0.10.2641; Veritas records a single ground-truth OOB for this commit.
